title: Possum Pouch
description: Craftable mob pouches for capturing creatures! (Reusable and single-use)
body:
# Possum Pouch

## Overview 
Adds **craftable mob pouches** to the game, which come in reusable and single-use versions. They are textured like bundles, functioning when right-clicked on a capturable creature.
## Features
- Ability to **blacklist any mobs** you'd like (no capturing bosses, for instance).
- **Changes texture** based on what creature is inside (spawn egg textures).
- **Togglable pet protection** which keeps players from picking up animals tamed by someone else. 
- Ability to **trust other players**, so that they can pick your tamed animals up.
- Can pick up mobs with passengers, preserving their **placement hierarchy** (this works for camel husks and their riders, spider jockeys, chicken jockeys, and more!)
- Placeable onto **incomplete blocks** and slabs.
- Supports being placed on the **sides** of blocks, and **the underside** of blocks. 
- Operator-only controls.
- In-game **reloadable config** file. 

## Global Commands

### /mp trust <player>
Trust a player to pick up mobs you've tamed.

### /mp untrust <player> 
Untrust a player from picking up mobs you've tamed.

## Operator-Only Commands

### /mp enable
Enable the plugin.

### /mp disable
Disable the plugin.

### /mp status
Display all applicable plugin information to the user.

### /mp reload
Reload the config.yml and trusts.yml files.
